text:
Leah (PM): quick sync on carryover / grace-window idea for reserved pools. customers ask to not lose tiny leftover burst credits at month-end.
Omar (Infra): idea: allow a short grace-window carryover (e.g., 24h) so unused burst tokens roll into the next billing period but only for scheduled events. keeps infra simpler than unlimited carryover.
Noah (SRE): ops concern: carryover introduces spike risk at boundary (monthly reset). need admission soft-guard that smooths carried tokens (throttle ramp for first 10 minutes).
Priya (Revenue): commercial note: finance wants deterministic invoicing. carryover must be zero-sum on invoice (show credit used vs carried) and visible in export. we can support small carryover as promo credit vs billing credit.
Zoe (Data): analytics ask: surface carryover_token_count and carryover_window_id in export. also add a retention label so billing queries can join.
Leah (PM): proposed MVP rules: 1) carryover allowed only up to carryover_limit_pct (5% default) and max 48h window, 2) only for burst_allowance (not reserved_quota), 3) carryover flagged in billing export.
Omar (Infra): API sketch:
```
PUT /v1/tenants/:id/capacity
{ "reserved_quota": 1000000, "burst_allowance": 200000, "carryover": {"enabled": true, "max_pct": 5, "window_hr": 24} }
```
Noah (SRE): runtime checks: at period boundary mark carryover rows with expiry, and admission will honor carried tokens but enforce ramp_rate (e.g., 20% of carried tokens per minute) to avoid thundering herd. also add alert on sudden jump >x tokens/min.
Priya (Revenue): default behavior? finance prefers carryover disabled by default for GA. enable via opt-in during onboarding or as a paid feature.
Leah (PM): decision: opt-in carryover for GA with defaults max_pct=5 and window_hr=24, ramp_rate enforced. must-haves: billing export fields carryover_used, carryover_id; dashboard shows carried tokens.
Zoe (Data): acceptance tests: simulate month boundary with overlapping events and verify attribution, export correctness, and ramp enforcement.
Omar (Infra): implementation plan: 2 sprints: sprint 1 ledger + carryover rows + export; sprint 2 admission ramp + alerts + console toggle.
deploy-bot: created RFC DCR-5333: "carryover-grace-window: opt-in burst carryover + ramped admission" linked to product board.
Leah (PM): thanks all. next: Priya & Zoe to draft billing examples, Omar/Noah to break into tasks. reconvene after sprint planning. :thumbsup:
